name: Gayatri Mantra
sanskrit:
ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं
भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
meaningEn: We meditate on the adorable radiance of the divine Savitr, the source of all that exists. May that light inspire and illumine our intellect.
meaningHi: हम उस प्रकाशमय, वरणीय सविता देव के तेज का ध्यान करते हैं। वे हमारी बुद्धि को सत्कर्म की ओर प्रेरित करें।
benefits: Traditionally chanted at sandhya (dawn, noon, dusk) for clarity of mind and spiritual discipline.
pronunciationTips: Say 'varenyam' as va-re-ṇ-yam (retroflex ṇ). 'Bhargo' has an aspirated bh. Hold the final 't' of 'prachodayāt' crisply without adding a vowel.

name: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
sanskrit:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे
सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्
मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्
meaningEn: We worship the three-eyed One, fragrant, who nourishes all beings. As a ripe cucumber is released from its stalk, may He free us from death, not from immortality.
meaningHi: हम त्रिनेत्रधारी, सुगंधित, समस्त जीवों का पोषण करने वाले भगवान शिव की उपासना करते हैं। जैसे पका हुआ खरबूजा बेल से सहज अलग हो जाता है, वैसे ही वे हमें मृत्यु के बंधन से मुक्त करें, अमरत्व से नहीं।
benefits: Chanted for healing, protection and inner peace; commonly recited during illness and on Mondays.
pronunciationTips: 'Tryambakam' begins with a cluster tr-y; do not say 'tri-yam'. 'Mṛtyor' uses the vocalic ṛ (like 'ri' said quickly). Pause slightly at 'mā' before 'amṛtāt'.

name: Panchakshari Mantra
meaningEn: Om, salutations to Shiva, the auspicious one.
meaningHi: ॐ, कल्याणकारी भगवान शिव को नमस्कार।
benefits: The five-syllable mantra (na-maḥ-śi-vā-ya); used for japa and meditation.
pronunciationTips: The visarga in 'namaḥ' is a soft echo 'ha'. 'Śivāya' uses the palatal ś and a long ā.

name: Vakratunda Mahakaya
sanskrit:
वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय
सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ
निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव
सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा
meaningEn: O Lord with the curved trunk and mighty form, radiant as a million suns: make all my undertakings free of obstacles, always.
meaningHi: हे वक्र सूँड़ वाले, विशाल शरीर वाले, करोड़ों सूर्यों के समान तेजस्वी देव! मेरे सभी कार्य सदा निर्विघ्न पूर्ण करें।
benefits: Recited before beginning any new work, puja or journey.
pronunciationTips: 'Tuṇḍa' has a retroflex ṇḍ. 'Nirvighnaṃ' ends with an anusvāra (nasal hum).

name: Hare Krishna Mahamantra
sanskrit:
हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण
कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे
हरे राम हरे राम
राम राम हरे हरे
meaningEn: An invocation of the divine names Hare, Krishna and Rama, calling upon the Lord and His energy.
meaningHi: हरे, कृष्ण और राम - भगवान और उनकी शक्ति के पवित्र नामों का आह्वान।
benefits: Kirtan and japa; widely chanted in congregational singing.
pronunciationTips: 'Kṛṣṇa' has vocalic ṛ and retroflex ṣṇ. Keep 'Rāma' with a long ā.

name: Saha Navavatu (Shanti Mantra)
sanskrit:
ॐ सह नाववतु
सह नौ भुनक्तु
सह वीर्यं करवावहै
तेजस्वि नावधीतमस्तु मा विद्विषावहै
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः
meaningEn: May the Divine protect us both (teacher and student), nourish us both, may we work together with vigour, may our study be illuminating, and may we never be hostile to each other. Om peace, peace, peace.
meaningHi: ईश्वर हम दोनों (गुरु और शिष्य) की रक्षा करें, हम दोनों का पोषण करें, हम साथ मिलकर पराक्रम करें, हमारा अध्ययन तेजस्वी हो और हम कभी परस्पर द्वेष न करें। ॐ शांति, शांति, शांति।
benefits: Recited at the start of study and in classrooms.
pronunciationTips: 'Nāvavatu' = nau + avatu (long ā). 'Vīryaṃ' has a long ī.

name: Purnamadah Purnamidam
sanskrit:
ॐ पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदं
पूर्णात्पूर्णमुदच्यते
पूर्णस्य पूर्णमादाय
पूर्णमेवावशिष्यते
meaningEn: That is whole, this is whole. From the whole, the whole arises. Taking the whole from the whole, the whole alone remains.
meaningHi: वह पूर्ण है, यह पूर्ण है। पूर्ण से पूर्ण उत्पन्न होता है। पूर्ण में से पूर्ण निकाल लेने पर भी पूर्ण ही शेष रहता है।
benefits: Shanti mantra on the completeness of Brahman; recited before Upanishad study.
pronunciationTips: 'Pūrṇam' has a long ū and retroflex ṇ. 'Udacyate' - 'c' is like 'ch' in 'church'.

name: Guru Mantra
sanskrit:
गुरुर्ब्रह्मा गुरुर्विष्णुः
गुरुर्देवो महेश्वरः
गुरुः साक्षात् परब्रह्म
तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः
meaningEn: The Guru is Brahma, the Guru is Vishnu, the Guru is Lord Maheshwara. The Guru is verily the supreme Brahman; salutations to that revered Guru.
meaningHi: गुरु ही ब्रह्मा हैं, गुरु ही विष्णु हैं, गुरु ही महेश्वर हैं। गुरु साक्षात् परब्रह्म हैं, ऐसे श्री गुरु को नमस्कार।
benefits: Recited on Guru Purnima and before learning.
pronunciationTips: Join 'gurur-brahmā' smoothly (the r carries into the next word).

name: Dvadashakshari Mantra
meaningEn: Om, salutations to Lord Vasudeva, the all-pervading Divine.
meaningHi: ॐ, सर्वव्यापी भगवान वासुदेव को नमस्कार।
benefits: The twelve-syllable mantra of Vishnu, used for japa and devotion.
pronunciationTips: 'Bhagavate' - aspirated bh, short a's. 'Vāsudevāya' - long ā twice.

name: Asato Ma Sadgamaya
sanskrit:
ॐ असतो मा सद्गमय
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय
ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः
meaningEn: Lead me from the unreal to the real, from darkness to light, from death to immortality. Om peace, peace, peace.
meaningHi: मुझे असत्य से सत्य की ओर, अंधकार से प्रकाश की ओर, मृत्यु से अमरता की ओर ले चलो। ॐ शांति, शांति, शांति।
benefits: The Pavamana mantra; a universal prayer for wisdom.
pronunciationTips: 'Sadgamaya' - the d and g are both pronounced. 'Jyotir' - 'jy' cluster.
